insertText.text:
LOD-MUSIC-IMPLEMENTATION — Provisional source parameters; native audio acceptance pending
Server master lod_music_enabled defaults OFF (0); only the server may enable it. Player Music defaults On and never overrides server Off. Four physical-floor assignments are reserved from the music-only seed stream, covering the maximum existing maze layers; active/offered plans and their role sources remain frozen. The companion ingestion service queues a catalog reload consumed at the next new plan boundary.
IMPLEMENTATION-TUNABLE initial values: listener update 0.2 seconds; envelope fade 1.2 seconds; escalation 0.8 seconds, relaxation 6 seconds, minimum dwell 4 seconds; urgent danger bypasses dwell. Recent confirmed damage/combat window 5 seconds; three recent received hits or HP at/below 40% or effective clock at/below 180 seconds requests T2; HP at/below 20% or effective clock at/below 60 seconds requests T3. Staging remains T0. Incoming audio requires 0.3 seconds of buffered lead and matched grid/phase before seeking. Unrelated grids use an authored-start envelope handoff.
Resource bounds: four total native score slots, at most two pending/incomplete transfers, 4 MiB and 180 seconds per file, no disk cache, no background library download, at most one attempt per source per plan/campaign context before bounded role fallback. Native callbacks that cannot yet be cancelled retain their slot until they return and are discarded after Off/reset. Startup/reload validation caps catalog at 256 blocks and 1,792 assets; compressed plan transport at 60,000 bytes. These are bounded implementation choices, not measured native bandwidth/memory guarantees.
Original D-Dorian Foundations starter defaults are generated offline by tools/music/generate_defaults.py as seven role-specific Vorbis files (stereo 44.1 kHz, nominal 128 kbps, loops 16 seconds, fanfare 6.5 seconds). They are separate operator-hosted assets and require native audition/hosting acceptance; no 32-block album, deployed HTTPS origin, sample-accurate alignment or native performance acceptance is claimed. Source validation and remaining finite native gate belong in docs/MUSIC_SYSTEM.md.
